items.title: What Microsoft learned from purchasing millions of carbon removal credits
items.summary: Microsoft’s appetite for carbon removal far outstrips that of any other company: The tech giant has purchased five times more removal credits than the next 10 largest buyers combined, according to CDR.fyi, a data and analytics provider.
